W: Hello, everyone! I'll talk about my first day of senior high school. ⑰ I woke up early this morning, as today was the day when I would begin my journey of senior high school. Thousands of thoughts rushed through my mind. Will I fit in? Will I feel awkward when I talk to new classmates? Will I have nice teachers?

At 7 a.m. I put on my coat and smiled in front of the mirror hoping for a good day. My bag weighed me down, but I stood up tall and proud. ⑱⑲I arrived at the school hall with welcoming smiles at 8 a.m. Then we had a tour of the school and there's a lot to explore at school. I just hoped I could remember it all when I needed to. Then we headed for our classroom to meet our classmates. I was happy with my classmates as they were all nice. In the afternoon we got to know our teachers a bit more and they were friendly and helpful. ⑲At 5 p.m. when I knew the day was over, I didn't know why I wasn't nervous any more. ⑳High school may seem frightening but it's just like primary school or junior high school. I love high school now. It's the best thing of all.

场景预判——通过开头句式快速锁定对话情境
在这段听力材料中，开头句“Excuse me. Can I ask you a few questions?”是一个典型的“​街头调研 / 采访场景”的启动句式。掌握这类标志性表达，能帮助你在听力中迅速预判对话场景，从而更准确地抓取关键信息。
设计师服装（designer clothes）是由知名时尚设计师或奢侈品牌（如 Chanel 香奈儿、Gucci 古驰、Louis Vuitton 路易·威登、Givenchy 纪梵希）设计的高端服装，具有奢侈性、限量性和高溢价特点，在西方象征着财富、身份、地位、阶层等。
同义表达：programmer
open的英语释义很灵活，需要根据语境具体理解，此处意为“可选的/可报名的”。
通常用于​表达同情或安慰，类似的表达还有you poor thing。
注意重音位置。
通过对话开头的直接疑问或陈述，快速抓取说话人的核心意图（如求助、道歉、邀请等）。What do you think I should do?是一个非常典型的“询问建议”的常用句型。其他常见的句型，还有“Any ideas about …?”“I'd love to hear …”等。

选课在国外大学以​​“###自主选择 + 先到先得###”为核心，学生需在###规定时间内###主动注册课程，热门课常需抢位，逾期或满员后通常无法补选，强调个人规划和责任。所选的课程通常分为###必修课（Required Courses）和​​### ###选修课（Electives）：###必修课是专业或学位强制要求完成的课程，学生必须修读；选修课​​则是学生根据兴趣或学分需求自由选择的课程，可拓展知识或补充专业方向。

analysis.标题: 交换生和国际生/留学生
analysis.内容/说明:
交换生​ （exchange students）通常指短期（如1学期或1年）参与校际交换项目的学生，可能保留原学校学籍。 
​国际生 / 留学生（ international students​）泛指所有在非本国接受教育的外国学生，包括长期留学（如攻读学位）。
在非正式口语或简化表达中，有时可互换使用。

美国高中课程设置（9-12 年级）普遍实行学分制毕业，学生需修满 20—26 学分（credit）（各州要求不同）方可毕业。通常每学年需完成 5—7 门课程（course），课程分必修课（Required Courses）与选修课（Electives）：必修核心课程包括英语、数学、科学、社会研究 / 历史等；选修课程涵盖艺术、职业技术、体育健康等。课程按难度分为普通班（Regular）、荣誉班（Honors）和大学先修课（AP/IB）。

analysis.内容/说明: 新西兰（New Zealand）位于大洋洲澳大利亚（Australia）东南方，隔海 1500 公里，由南北岛及小岛组成，居民以欧裔、毛利裔（Maori）为主。它因《指环王》（**The Lord of the Rings**）取景地、星空保护区和毛利文化闻名，是户外爱好者的天堂；同时拥有高性价比世界名校，毕业生可获 3 年工签，移民政策友好，适合追求优质教育与生活平衡的学生。
哥伦比亚大学（Columbia University）是美国常春藤名校（Ivy League，由八所顶尖私立大学组成）之一，以新闻、医学、商学等学科著称，创立了普利策奖（Pulitzer Prize），培养出罗斯福（Roosevelt）、奥巴马（Obama）、巴菲特（Buffett）等杰出校友，陶行知、胡适等人也曾在此就读。

analysis.凸显: Thousands of thoughts rushed through my mind.
analysis.内容/说明: rush 的基本义是“冲”，传递出一种高速、急促的运动意象。本句中，它被巧妙地用于描述无形的思维活动，赋予抽象思绪以强烈的动感和紧迫性。而 thousands of thoughts 强调想法数量之庞大，与 rush 结合在一起，生动地呈现出大量想法在同一时刻争相涌入脑海的画面。整个句子是一个精彩的隐喻，以 rush 为核心，将无形的心理活动转化为具象、生动的场景。
analysis.例句: Thousands of thoughts rushed through my mind.

analysis.内容/说明: 本句中 weigh 的用法一语双关，书包不仅有重量，更是给人带来一种“沉重”的压力。But 后内容转折，通过“重压”和“挺立”的对比，表达说话人克服困难的决心和精神​​。
写作妙词：原句提到“there's a lot to explore”，暗示学校有很多“待发现的亮点”。用“explore”更贴切，能呼应这种“未知感”和“趣味性”，仿佛学校像一个充满惊喜的宝藏地。而“visit”则更偏向“访问；到此一游”，体现不出这种探索的乐趣，显得更平淡。

timeline.录音稿: Excuse me, can I become a member of the club?

timeline.线索句: can I become a member of the club?

timeline.录音稿: Sure. Everyone is welcome, whatever your age, sex or nationality is.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 当然可以。无论年龄、性别或国籍，我们都欢迎。

timeline.录音稿: Here's my sales report; you're gonna need that for Monday's ...

timeline.录音稿: Yes. The prices are not bad. A large bowl of noodle soup is $6, and a bowl of fried noodles with chicken costs $8.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 去过。价格还不错。一大碗汤面6美元，一碗鸡肉炒面8美元。
timeline.线索句: The prices are not bad.

timeline.录音稿: Maybe I could just get a little flat near campus — a little one-room place by myself.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 也许我可以在校园附近整个小公寓——就我自己住的小单间。

timeline.录音稿: A flat alone?

timeline.录音稿: Yeah! If I live alone, I can be messy if I want to, and I won't annoy anyone else with my mess.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是啊！要是我一个人住，想怎么乱就怎么乱，也不会因为我乱而烦到别人。
timeline.线索句: If I live alone, I can be messy if I want to, and I won't annoy anyone else with my mess.

timeline.录音稿: Excuse me. Can I ask you a few questions?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 打扰一下，我能问你几个问题吗？

timeline.录音稿: Yes. OK.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 可以。行啊。

timeline.录音稿: Erm … Do you ever buy designer clothes?

timeline.录音稿: Well, yes, I do. These jeans, actually. I got them in a store in New York.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗯，买的。就说这条牛仔裤吧，我是在纽约的一家店里买的。

timeline.录音稿: Hey, Sarah. I forgot to register for the courses. I'm one day late. What do you think I should do?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗨，萨拉。我忘了选课报名，晚了一天。你觉得我该怎么办？
timeline.线索句: Hey, Sarah. I forgot to register for the courses. I'm one day late. What do you think I should do?

timeline.录音稿: Poor you, Jack! You can't do anything about that.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 杰克，你真惨！这事你可没办法了。

timeline.录音稿: Do you think going to the registration office will help now?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你觉得现在去注册办公室会有用吗？

timeline.录音稿: No, they will tell you the same thing.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 没用，他们也会这么跟你说。

timeline.录音稿: Did you register yet?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你报名了吗？

timeline.录音稿: Of course, and it wasn't easy for me to register for the course. It's so popular. And it is designed for beginners. I want to be a program designer in the future.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 当然报了，而且我选上这门课可不容易。它太热门了，而且是面向初学者。我以后想当程序员。
timeline.线索句: it wasn't easy for me to register for the course. It's so popular. And it is designed for beginners. I want to be a program designer in the future.

timeline.录音稿: What classes do you think are still open?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你觉得还有哪些课没满？

timeline.录音稿: Maybe Modern History and Chemistry.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 也许是近代史和化学吧。

timeline.录音稿: Hi, I bought this pair of earphones yesterday, but when I got home, I realised it's not the model I wanted. So ...
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你好，我昨天买了这副耳机，可回家后发现不是我想要的型号。所以……

timeline.录音稿: I'm afraid I'm not allowed to do that once it's been opened, which this one has.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 恐怕不行，一经拆封我就无能为力了，而这副已经拆了。

timeline.录音稿: Well, I only opened it to check, and it's still in perfect condition.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 可是我只是拆开看看，它还完好无损呢。

timeline.录音稿: That's not the point. We never give money back on earphone sales.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 这不是重点。我们耳机售出概不退钱。

timeline.录音稿: I'm not asking you to do that, just to exchange a different model.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我不是要你退款，只是想换个别的型号。
timeline.线索句: just to exchange a different model.

timeline.录音稿: I'm sorry. I'm not allowed to do that.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 抱歉，我不能这么做。
timeline.线索句: I'm sorry. I'm not allowed to do that.

timeline.录音稿: Tom, what are you reading?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 汤姆，你在看什么？

timeline.录音稿: Some information about a star party.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 一些关于观星聚会的信息。

timeline.录音稿: A star party? Is that a party with a lot of movie stars or something?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 观星聚会？是有很多电影明星参加的派对之类的吗？

timeline.录音稿: No, Cindy. At the star party, people get together to look at the night sky.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 不是，辛迪。在观星聚会上，大家聚在一起看夜空。
timeline.线索句: At the star party, people get together to look at the night sky.

timeline.录音稿: Do you need to go to a party to do that?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 做这个还需要专门去参加聚会吗？

timeline.录音稿: Well, they're going to the countryside. It's far from any big cities or small towns.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是这样，他们要去乡下，那里远离大城市和小镇。
timeline.线索句: they're going to the countryside. It's far from any big cities or small towns.

timeline.录音稿: I see ... so there are no city lights.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我明白了……所以那里没有城市的灯光。

timeline.录音稿: Exactly. People say it's a lot of fun. Do you want to go?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 没错。大家都说特别有意思。你想去吗？
timeline.线索句: Do you want to go?

timeline.录音稿: OK. When?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 好啊。什么时候？

timeline.录音稿: The bus leaves at five o'clock on Friday afternoon, so everyone must get together at 4:30. It gets to the place around 7:30. And it gets back around midnight.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 大巴星期五下午五点出发，所以大家必须四点三十集合。大概七点三十到达目的地，回来大概是半夜。
timeline.线索句: The bus leaves at five o'clock on Friday afternoon,

timeline.录音稿: Hi, Susan! What's the matter with you?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗨，苏珊！你怎么了？

timeline.录音稿: I'm having such a bad day. First, my mum's car wouldn't start, luckily my neighbour helped send me to school but I was late for school. Miss Smith was angry because it was the third time this month. Then I realised that I hadn't finished my English homework last night.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我今天真是倒霉透了。先是妈妈的车打不着火，幸好邻居帮忙送我去学校，可我还是迟到了。史密斯小姐很生气，因为这个月已经是第三次了。然后我发现昨晚的英语作业我没做完。

timeline.录音稿: Oh, no! What happened then?

timeline.录音稿翻译: 哦，不用。别管我，我得专心写论文。
timeline.线索句: Just leave me alone.

timeline.录音稿: Hey, did you receive the information from Mr Johnson?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嘿，你收到约翰逊先生的消息了吗？

timeline.录音稿: No, not yet. What did he say?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 还没呢。他说什么了？

timeline.录音稿: He sent an email about the upcoming project. I'll forward his email to you.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 他发了一封关于即将开展的项目的邮件。我把他的邮件转发给你。
timeline.线索句: He sent an email about the upcoming project. I'll forward his email to you.

timeline.录音稿: Is the party still on the eleventh?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 派对还是定在十一号吗？

timeline.录音稿: That gives us too little time to prepare for it. And the place's booked up on the twenty-seventh. So I decide to change it to the date of the twenty-fifth at last.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 那样我们准备的时间太少了。而且二十七号场地订满了。所以我最后决定改到二十五号。
timeline.线索句: So I decide to change it to the date of the twenty-fifth at last.

timeline.录音稿: Irene, your hard work really left me with a deep impression.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 艾琳，你的努力真让我印象深刻。

timeline.录音稿: I'm into chemistry so much, so for me it's not very much like work. Whenever there is free time, I'd like to spend it on my experiment.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我太喜欢化学了，所以对我来说这不太像工作。一有空我就想花在实验上。
timeline.线索句: I'm into chemistry so much, so for me it's not very much like work. Whenever there is free time, I'd like to spend it on my experiment.

timeline.录音稿: This is the first football match I've ever watched live, and the experience is completely different from watching it on TV.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 这是我第一次现场看足球比赛，感觉和看电视转播完全不同。
timeline.线索句: This is the first football match I've ever watched live,

timeline.录音稿: Yeah, the game was really exciting. Our team won really well. Four goals to one is a great result.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是啊，比赛真精彩。我们队赢得很漂亮。四比一是很棒的成绩。

timeline.录音稿: Hi, Mary!
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗨，玛丽！

timeline.录音稿: Hello, Mark!
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你好，马克！

timeline.录音稿: You look a little pale. What's up? Worried about our maths exam or the experiment in the afternoon?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 你脸色有点苍白。怎么了？担心我们的数学考试还是下午的实验？

timeline.录音稿: No. I'm just a little anxious about my singing competition tomorrow.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 不是。我只是对明天的歌唱比赛有点紧张。
timeline.线索句: I'm just a little anxious about my singing competition tomorrow.

timeline.录音稿: Don't worry. You've been practising for a long time. I think you've got confidence from earlier preparation. I'm sure you'll do great.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 别担心。你已经练了很久了。我觉得之前的准备给了你信心。我相信你会表现得很棒。
timeline.线索句: Don't worry. You've been practising for a long time. I think you've got confidence from earlier preparation. I'm sure you'll do great.

timeline.录音稿: Thanks, Mark! I needed that. I'll do my best tomorrow.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 谢谢你，马克！这话我正需要听。明天我会尽力的。

timeline.录音稿: We're going to the Three Towers Theme Park. I'm so excited.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我们要去三塔主题公园了。我太兴奋了。

timeline.录音稿: Really? I hate theme parks. I went last summer and the roller coaster was way too frightening.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 真的吗？我讨厌主题公园。我去年夏天去过，那个过山车太吓人了。

timeline.录音稿: Really? I heard it was fantastic!
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是吗？我听说很棒啊！

timeline.录音稿: Well, it is, if you want to be frightened out of your mind. I thought Ghost Ride was better.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗯，如果你想要吓破胆的话，确实很棒。我觉得“幽灵之旅”更好玩。

timeline.录音稿: No, I went on that last year and I was totally annoyed. The food was terrible. And the ride was boring. I'm looking forward to going on the roller coaster.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 才不呢，我去年玩过那个，烦死了。吃的很难吃，那个项目也很无聊。我倒是盼着坐过山车。
timeline.线索句: I went on that last year and I was totally annoyed. The food was terrible. And the ride was boring.

timeline.录音稿: The party was great yesterday, wasn't it?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 昨天的派对很棒，对吧？

timeline.录音稿: Yes, I really enjoyed it. The music was great and the food was excellent.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是啊，我玩得很开心。音乐很棒，吃的也很好。

timeline.录音稿: The people were interesting too. Ian introduced me to Laura Singer. Did you meet her?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 人也挺有意思。伊恩把我介绍给了劳拉·辛格。你见过她吗？

timeline.录音稿: I don't think so. Can you give a description of her?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 应该没有。你能描述一下她吗？

timeline.录音稿: She's short and thin, with dark black hair and green eyes. She was in a blue dress yesterday.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 她个子不高，很瘦，头发乌黑，眼睛是绿色的。昨天穿了一条蓝色连衣裙。

timeline.录音稿: And what is she like?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 她这个人怎么样？

timeline.录音稿: She's outgoing, helpful and independent. I was deeply impressed with her kindness. She's been to New Zealand and Africa.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 她外向、乐于助人，也很独立。她的善良给我留下了很深的印象。她去过新西兰和非洲。
timeline.线索句: I was deeply impressed with her kindness.

timeline.录音稿: Really? That's so impressive.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 真的吗？太了不起了。

timeline.录音稿: And that's not all. In January she won the National Writing Competition and next September she is going to Columbia University to study Creative Writing!
timeline.录音稿翻译: 还不止这些。一月份她赢得了全国写作比赛，明年九月她要去哥伦比亚大学学创意写作！
timeline.线索句: next September she is going to Columbia University to study Creative Writing!

timeline.录音稿: I'd love to meet her.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我很想见见她。
timeline.线索句: I'd love to meet her.

timeline.录音稿: Well, we're thinking of going to the cinema tomorrow. Why not join us?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 嗯，我们打算明天去看电影。你为什么不一起来呢？

timeline.录音稿: Sure, that'd be great!
timeline.录音稿翻译: 好啊，那太好了！

timeline.录音稿: Excuse me, but is your name Lisa Evans? Mr Smith said that I should speak with you before I carry out an experiment.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 打扰一下，你是莉萨·埃文斯吗？史密斯先生说，我在做实验之前应该先跟你说一声。
timeline.线索句: I should speak with you before I carry out an experiment.

timeline.录音稿: Yes. First time in the lab?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是的。第一次来实验室吗？

timeline.录音稿: Yeah. I'm not really sure what I'm supposed to do.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 是的。我不太清楚我该做什么。

timeline.录音稿: Let me go over some of the safety rules in the lab so that you know how to act properly while you're here. Remember these to make sure that you don't do any harm to yourself or your lab partner.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我来给你讲讲实验室的一些安全规则，好让你在这儿知道该怎么正确操作。记住这些，确保你不会伤到自己或你的实验搭档。
timeline.线索句: Let me go over some of the safety rules in the lab so that you know how to act properly while you're here.

timeline.录音稿: OK, what do I need to know?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 好的，我需要知道些什么？

timeline.录音稿: First of all, you will not joke around, nor will you run, fight, or play games. And you need to wear proper clothes in the lab. This means you must wear a lab coat the whole time. You must also wear gloves, and you also need to wear safety glasses.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 首先，不许打闹，也不许奔跑、打斗或玩游戏。而且在实验室要穿合适的衣服。也就是说，你必须全程穿实验服，还必须戴手套，也需要戴护目镜。
timeline.线索句: you must wear a lab coat the whole time.

timeline.录音稿: But what if I have to run to the bathroom or something?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 可如果我要跑去洗手间什么的呢？

timeline.录音稿: When that happens, you need to take off all of your protective clothing and put it into the cleaning basket over there ...
timeline.录音稿翻译: 遇到那种情况，你得把防护服全部脱下来，放到那边的清洁筐里……

timeline.录音稿: Hello, everyone! I'll talk about my first day of senior high school.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 大家好！我要讲讲我高中生活的第一天。

timeline.录音稿: I woke up early this morning, as today was the day when I would begin my journey of senior high school.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 今天早上我很早就醒了，因为今天是我开启高中生活的日子。

timeline.录音稿: Thousands of thoughts rushed through my mind. Will I fit in? Will I feel awkward when I talk to new classmates?
timeline.录音稿翻译: 无数念头涌上我的心头。我能融入大家吗？和新同学说话时我会不会感到尴尬？

timeline.录音稿: Will I have nice teachers? At 7 a.m. I put on my coat and smiled in front of the mirror hoping for a good day.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我会遇到好老师吗？早上七点，我穿上外套，对着镜子笑了笑，希望这一天顺顺利利。

timeline.录音稿: My bag weighed me down, but I stood up tall and proud.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 书包压得我有些沉，但我依然站得笔直，心里满是自豪。

timeline.录音稿: I arrived at the school hall with welcoming smiles at 8 a.m.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 上午八点，我来到学校礼堂，迎接我的是一张张热情的笑脸。

timeline.录音稿: Then we had a tour of the school and there's a lot to explore at school.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 随后我们参观了学校，校园里有很多值得探索的地方。

timeline.录音稿: I just hoped I could remember it all when I needed to. Then we headed for our classroom to meet our classmates.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 我只希望需要的时候能把这些都记住。之后我们前往教室去见新同学。

timeline.录音稿: I was happy with my classmates as they were all nice.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 同学们都很友善，和他们在一起我很开心。

timeline.录音稿: In the afternoon we got to know our teachers a bit more and they were friendly and helpful.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 下午我们进一步了解了老师们，他们既友好又乐于助人。

timeline.录音稿: At 5 p.m. when I knew the day was over, I didn't know why I wasn't nervous any more.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 下午五点，当我意识到这一天已经结束时，我也不知道自己为什么不再紧张了。

timeline.录音稿: High school may seem frightening but it's just like primary school or junior high school. I love high school now.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 高中看起来或许令人害怕，但它其实和小学、初中没什么两样。我现在喜欢上高中了。

timeline.录音稿: It's the best thing of all.
timeline.录音稿翻译: 这是最美好的一件事。
